#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int cache[1111111];
long long base[30];
long long current=6;

int computeCost(long long num) {
    int length=0;
    if (num<0) num=-num;
    if (num<=current) return cache[num];

    long long lastDigit;
    long long temp=num;
    while (temp>0) {
        length++;
        lastDigit=temp;
        temp/=10;
    }

    if (lastDigit<=5) {
        if (num>=base[length]*lastDigit || lastDigit==1)
            return computeCost(num - base[length]*lastDigit) + lastDigit*length;
        else {
            int cost1=computeCost(base[length]*lastDigit - num)+lastDigit*length;
            int cost2=computeCost(num - base[length]*(lastDigit-1))+(lastDigit-1)*length;
            return min(cost1, cost2);
        }
    } else if (lastDigit>6) {
        return computeCost(base[length+1]-num)+length+1;
    } else {
        int cost1, cost2;
        if (num > base[length]*lastDigit)
            cost1=computeCost(num - base[length]*lastDigit)+lastDigit*length;
        else
            cost1=computeCost(base[length]*lastDigit - num)+lastDigit*length;
        cost2=computeCost(num - base[length]*(lastDigit-1))+(lastDigit-1)*length;
        int minCost=min(cost1, cost2);
        int cost3=computeCost(base[length+1]-num)+length+1;
        return min(minCost, cost3);
    }
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    base[1]=1;
    for (int i=2; i<=15; i++) {
        base[i]=base[i-1]*10+1;
